:: Keeping discussion pages helps prevents the same discussions from occuring again and again.  Even if they are several pages long, they are easy to use when all ==new topic== sections are added at the bottom (beneath all older discussions), so as to have a chronological history. The table of contents lets you jump to the bottom quickly. When a discussion page becomes unreasonably long (3-5 pages, typically), it can be moved to an [[/Archive]] subpage. (and later [[/Archive 2]], 3, etc.).  For an example of the usefulness of multiple archive pages, see [[Wikipedia:talk:Intelligent design#Archives]] --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 03:12, 5 October 2006 (UTC)

Also, please sign all your posts. --[[User:TheParanoidOne|TheParanoidOne]] 07:35, 2 October 2006 (UTC)
